content.text:
The task is to decide whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests any numbered claims. The claims are a migration report about a previous feature (an interaction of stress-type variables, invalid submission, regime dependence, etc.).

The hypothesis concerns V05's year-over-year change, smoothed and standardized, predicting next-month returns. It doesn't reference an interaction, regime conditioning, or any of the claims' content. It mentions "raises rank stability", which loosely touches claim 7 (rank autocorrelation was moderate), but it doesn't test or depend on that claim. It is a new, different feature, not an application of a claim's finding.

The expression is a single-variable transform, with no interaction or regime condition.

Nothing substantive links to the claims.

{"uses_claim": false, "claim_ids": []}
